# Worldant

> Worldant is a filesystem-authored runtime for immediate application functions and durable
> processes, backed by a single embedded PostgreSQL engine that is both truth and realtime source.
> This repository is the public product, packaging, release, and support surface. The runtime
> implementation is proprietary and lives in a separate private repository.

Worldant has exactly two public callable concepts. Do not present any other artifact kind as current.

- Command — an immediate, non-durable application function. A default-exported `(input) => result`
  under `apps/<app>/commands/`. It may read and write PostgreSQL and schedule Workflows. Each
  standalone `db.one/many/exec` is its own transaction; `db.transaction(cb)` opens one explicit
  transaction scoped to the `tx` handle.
- Workflow — a durable, deterministic orchestration. A default-exported async function under
  `apps/<app>/workflows/`. It replays from a PostgreSQL journal, calls Steps and child Workflows,
  and uses durable wait primitives. It has no direct database, network, filesystem, clock, or
  randomness access.
- Step — an INTERNAL Workflow IO checkpoint under `apps/<app>/workflows/steps/`. A Step is never a
  public callable kind and is never addressable through the public protocol. Step database effects
  join one kernel-owned transaction and commit atomically with durable completion.

Removed concepts: Query, Mutation, Reactive/Rule, Goal, and generic Action are NOT current artifact
or protocol concepts. Collection synchronization and event streams are kernel/protocol facilities,
not authored artifacts.

The public wire protocol publishes two entry types: `Call -> Command` and `Run -> Workflow`.

## Install and verify
- [Installation](https://github.com/Midwess/worldant/blob/main/INSTALL.md): npm-based thin installer that verifies a signed release manifest before running any binary.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Midwess/worldant/blob/main/SECURITY.md): signature, checksum, SBOM, and provenance model; how to report vulnerabilities.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Midwess/worldant/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): the public distribution model begins at 1.0.0.

## Docs
- [Quickstart](https://worldant.dev/docs/quickstart): install, init a world, author a Command, build, serve.
- [Commands](https://worldant.dev/docs/commands): immediate functions and explicit transactions.
- [Workflows](https://worldant.dev/docs/workflows): durable deterministic orchestration and replay.
- [Steps](https://worldant.dev/docs/steps): internal Workflow IO checkpoints; never publicly callable.
- [Transactions](https://worldant.dev/docs/transactions): standalone commits vs `db.transaction` vs kernel-owned Step transactions.
- [Configuration](https://worldant.dev/docs/configuration): optional `worldant.ts` bootstrap and ordered middleware.
- [Deployment](https://worldant.dev/docs/deployment): snapshots, serving, and compatibility.
- [Troubleshooting](https://worldant.dev/docs/troubleshooting): install verification and common failures.

## Optional
- [Compatibility](https://worldant.dev/docs/compatibility): supported targets and version policy.
